# Environment variables

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TFCENSUS_CONFIG` | Config file to read instead of the discovered project file, as --config does. |
| `TFCENSUS_<KEY>` | Sets a config key; the [configuration](/reference/config) page names the variable of each key. An unknown `TFCENSUS_` variable is ignored with a warning. |
| `AWS_PROFILE` | Profile for the default credentials when no --profile, --org or accounts setting names one. |
| `AWS_CONFIG_FILE` | AWS shared config file to read profiles from, instead of ~/.aws/config. |
| `AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE` | AWS shared credentials file, instead of ~/.aws/credentials. Only profile names are read from it. |
| `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL` | Endpoint for every AWS service, such as an emulator. S3 then uses path-style addressing. |
| `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3` | Endpoint for S3 only. S3 then uses path-style addressing. |
| `AWS_*` | The AWS SDK reads its usual variables too, such as AWS\_REGION, AWS\_ACCESS\_KEY\_ID and AWS\_WEB\_IDENTITY\_TOKEN\_FILE. |
| `HOME` | Home directory: ~/.aws/config, the config and cache directories, and ~ in discovery.roots and path arguments. |
| `USERPROFILE` | Home directory on Windows when HOME is not set. |
| `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` | Base of the user config file: $XDG\_CONFIG\_HOME/tfcensus/config.yaml. |
| `XDG_CACHE_HOME` | Base of the cache directory: $XDG\_CACHE\_HOME/tfcensus. |
| `NO_COLOR` | Turns color off with --color auto when set to anything but an empty string. |
| `CLICOLOR_FORCE` | Turns color on with --color auto, even when output is not a terminal, unless it is 0 or NO\_COLOR is set. |
| `FORCE_COLOR` | Turns color on like CLICOLOR\_FORCE unless it is 0 or false. |
| `CLICOLOR` | Set to 0, turns color off with --color auto. |
| `TERM` | Set to dumb, turns color off with --color auto. |
| `COLUMNS` | Width in columns that tty output wraps notes and warnings at; default: the terminal's width. |
| `CI` | Any value turns prompts off, as no terminal does: move apply, rollback and mark-applied then need --yes. |
| `TG_IAM_ASSUME_ROLE` | Read like terragrunt does: when set, the fast path leaves get\_aws\_account\_id to terragrunt render, since terragrunt would assume that role first. |
| `TERRAGRUNT_IAM_ROLE` | The older name of TG\_IAM\_ASSUME\_ROLE, read the same way. |
| `PATH` | Where terragrunt, terraform and tofu are looked up, in the environment the child process gets. |
| `PATHEXT` | File extensions of programs on Windows, for the same lookup. |
| `SSL_CERT_FILE` | PEM file with more CA certificates for notify's HTTPS requests, such as a proxy's. |
| `GITHUB_REPOSITORY` | Repository for the github-issues and github-pr-comment notifiers when the config names none. |
| `GITHUB_API_URL` | GitHub API URL for the GitHub notifiers when the config names none. |
| `GITHUB_EVENT_PATH` | Event file that github-pr-comment reads the pull request number from in GitHub Actions. |
| `BITBUCKET_WORKSPACE` | Workspace for bitbucket-pr-comment when the config names none. |
| `BITBUCKET_REPO_SLUG` | Repository for bitbucket-pr-comment when the config names none. |
| `BITBUCKET_PR_ID` | Pull request for bitbucket-pr-comment when the config names none. |
| `GITHUB_TOKEN` | Token for the GitHub notifiers, the default of notify.github\_issues.token\_env and notify.github\_pr\_comment.token\_env. |
| `SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL` | Webhook URL for the slack notifier, the default of notify.slack.webhook\_env. |
| `BITBUCKET_TOKEN` | Token for bitbucket-pr-comment, the default of notify.bitbucket\_pr\_comment.token\_env. |

## Child processes

A child process, such as terraform, starts with only these variables from tfcensus's environment, plus the ones the command sets for it. A `*` matches any suffix.

`PATH`, `HOME`, `USER`, `LOGNAME`, `SHELL`, `TMPDIR`, `TEMP`, `TMP`, `TZ`, `TERM`, `LANG`, `LC_*`, `XDG_*`, `HTTP_PROXY`, `HTTPS_PROXY`, `NO_PROXY`, `http_proxy`, `https_proxy`, `no_proxy`, `SSL_CERT_FILE`, `SSL_CERT_DIR`, `AWS_*`, `TF_*`, `TG_*`, `TERRAGRUNT_*`, `TOFU_*`, `OPENTOFU_*`, `MISE_*`, `GIT_*`, `SSH_AUTH_SOCK`, `SYSTEMROOT`, `SystemRoot`, `COMSPEC`, `PATHEXT`, `WINDIR`, `APPDATA`, `LOCALAPPDATA`, `USERPROFILE`, `PROGRAMDATA`, `ProgramFiles`, `ProgramFiles(x86)`
